detail.longDescription:
See where any app ranks, in every country or region — at a glance.

Appboard brings top charts, app details, and rankings from stores around the world into one place. Whether you build apps or love discovering them, it's the fastest way to find and track the apps you care about.

DISCOVER
- Browse top free, paid, and category charts from stores worldwide
- Switch between regional stores in a tap
- Read app info in other languages with built-in translation

TRACK
- Check an app's rank across every country or region at once, on a map
- Pin your key stores and see how ranks changed since your last check
- Track where apps rank for the keywords you care about
- Add developers you care about and see their new apps and updates in one place

ORGANIZE & SHARE
- Collect apps in folders and add notes
- Bookmark the charts you check often
- Share ranking cards with your team or followers
- Check charts and app ranks from your Home Screen with widgets
- Sync across your devices with iCloud, and export your data anytime

APPBOARD PRO
Many features are free to try. Pro removes limits and unlocks everything, available as a subscription or a one-time purchase.
